title: Intel Email Record — discovered email address for a target org. Dedup key: address. Use linked_person_id to attribute to an intel-person row.

role_hint.description: Inferred or stated function (e.g., 'admin', 'support', 'security', 'cto'). Not the person's name — use linked_person_id for attribution.

linked_person_id.description: intel_people.id of the person this address belongs to. Obtain the ID from `vigil assess intel list person --json`.

source_name.description: Tool or source that surfaced this address (e.g., 'hunter.io', 'linkedin', 'emailfinder', 'github-scrape').

notes.description: Context: format pattern, breach exposure, deliverability result, MFA observed, or phishing-relevance notes.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row (e.g., 'osint-analyst').

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim source excerpt that confirms this address.
